findings: In extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective-plan.ts, readSessionSnapshot validates branch_summary.fromId by checking that it exists in ids, but does not verify ancestry. Therefore, an unrelated existing entry can be accepted as the summary's fromId despite the purported source range.

In extensions/navigate-tree/retrospective-plan.ts, readSessionSnapshot validates a label target against ids before adding the current entry.id. Since entries are processed in append order, targets that are forward references or self-references are rejected, while already-seen targets are accepted.
